scope: Persisted owner-editable Zema plan v1 and Cloud Agent approval gates

implementation.storage: WorkJob JSON payload stores schemaVersion 1, an editable objective, and server-derived approvalGates; no database migration is required
implementation.editing: Owner-authenticated, revision-checked plan edits are allowed only while active and before the first recorded step
cloudAgentGates: provider signed quote + native Wallet reservation + explicit Cloud execution approval
terminal remote state + captured artifact + stored usage receipt before result review
implementation.legacyCompatibility: Old WorkJob payloads are hydrated with plan v1; client input cannot set gates and persisted mismatches are normalized to server template requirements
implementation.authorityBoundary: Editing the parent objective does not modify the separate Agent request text and never carries forward execution approval
